rule_or_step_title: Exclusionary Criteria: Pure HSP / Isolated Spasticity
phenotype_name: Isolated spastic paraplegia without cognitive involvement
matching_criterion_description: An isolated spastic paraplegia phenotype without cognitive or adaptive deficits argues strongly against this diagnosis, as cognitive impairment is universally present in primary series.

rule_or_step_title: Exclusionary Criteria: Isolated Lower Motor Neuron Degeneration
phenotype_name: Isolated anterior horn cell loss / lower motor neuron degeneration
matching_criterion_description: Heterozygous MAPK8IP3 variants do not produce isolated anterior horn cell loss or spinal motor neuron degeneration in the absence of neurodevelopmental delay.

rule_or_step_title: Exclusionary Criteria: Early Severe Epileptic Encephalopathy
phenotype_name: Intractable early-infantile epileptic encephalopathy without significant motor or corpus callosum anomalies
matching_criterion_description: Seizures occur in fewer than 25% of patients overall; intractable early-infantile epileptic encephalopathy without motor or corpus callosum anomalies argues against MAPK8IP3 as the monogenic driver.

rule_or_step_title: Exclusionary Criteria: Isolated Primary Ocular Retinal/Optic Degeneration
phenotype_name: Primary photoreceptor dystrophy, optic atrophy, or anterior segment dysgenesis
matching_criterion_description: Ophthalmological involvement is restricted to secondary central cortical visual impairment (CVI); primary photoreceptor dystrophy, optic atrophy, or anterior segment dysgenesis argues against the condition.

phenotype_name: Obligate Cognitive/Language Delay + Mixed Tone + Thin Corpus Callosum
matching_criterion_description: Presence of complex triad (obligate cognitive/language delay + mixed tone + thin corpus callosum) yields high clinical confidence for MAPK8IP3-Related Disorder.
